svg.title: 3D Scene Understanding and Interaction

cc:Work.dc:title: 3D Scene Understanding and Interaction
cc:Work.dc:description: An official RoboCasa kitchen frame annotated with the four survey modules: scene perception, scene reconstruction, scene generation, and robots and embodied agents. The annotations are schematic research examples, not model predictions or recorded robot actions.

svg.title: 3D Scene Understanding and Interaction
svg.desc: An official RoboCasa kitchen frame annotated with four survey modules. A cabinet outline represents scene perception, a wireframe represents scene reconstruction, a room-layout outline represents scene generation, and a reach arrow represents robots and embodied agents. The annotations are schematic research examples, not model predictions or recorded robot actions.
